content: GitHub live-stats integration options: github-readme-stats/pin cards (rate-limited public instance, self-host recommended); custom GitHub REST/GraphQL API + client-side caching gives most control (filter no-forks/archived, config-based manual pinning); lightweight vanilla JS widgets exist for simple embeds. Recommended: custom API integration with config-based pinning (not full automation) to avoid third-party rate-limit fragility.
